unit: WF4 Approval Gate blocks a send as DUPLICATE when an OUTBOUND_PENDING Communications row exists on the same send_key
description: An APPROVE whose send_key already has an OUTBOUND_PENDING Communications row on the same action must return gate DUPLICATE and must not send again, because an unconfirmed prior attempt leaves delivery ambiguous and that ambiguity fails closed.
why_it_exists: Gate check 7b of wf4/approval-gate.js blocks a retry of the exact same draft when an earlier run reached the send step but never confirmed. Ambiguity about whether a legal communication was delivered must fail closed. The delivery-key families never supplied a pending row, so this block was unasserted. This pins that a pending row on the same idempotency key is a DUPLICATE, not a fresh send.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

gate_reason_contains: I tried to send this exact draft
expect.note: The pre-image of the send key is approval APR-A1B2C3D400000066 / action ACT-20260101-009-001 / draft DFT-20260101-009-001 / chan GMAIL / to claims.intake@insurer-notices.invalid, so send_key is SND-f483403b2e5e83b1. An OUTBOUND_PENDING row carrying that exact idempotency_key blocks the retry as DUPLICATE.

assertions: an APPROVE whose send_key already has an OUTBOUND_PENDING row returns gate DUPLICATE
the refusal tells the owner to check the sent mail, failing closed on the ambiguity
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
the gate is DUPLICATE, never SEND
